categories.main_business_segments: Dagang Holding Group operates primarily in high-end road surface equipment manufacturing, public facility intelligent operation and maintenance management, rural revitalization, and new energy-related businesses. The high-end road surface equipment segment includes asphalt heating, storage, transportation, road construction and maintenance vehicles, and asphalt mixing plants. The public facility segment focuses on integrated management platforms for urban infrastructure. The rural revitalization segment involves waste harmless treatment equipment, while the new energy segment centers on electric vehicle charging stations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as low-temperature pyrolysis and high-temperature incineration for waste treatment, and integrates mechanical, thermal, and aerodynamic principles in its equipment. Its road equipment manufacturing includes intelligent and environmentally friendly machinery with modular designs. The new energy segment uses modular assembly and smart IoT-enabled charging solutions. Production methods include both regular and special order manufacturing, with just-in-time and economic batch procurement strategies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government entities and enterprises involved in highway construction and maintenance, municipal and public facility management, rural waste management projects, and new energy vehicle manufacturers and charging infrastructure operators. The company serves domestic markets predominantly, with limited export sales. Its products and services are widely applied in highway construction, urban public infrastructure, rural environmental governance, and electric vehicle charging sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and major facilities in Xi'an and subsidiaries across provinces including Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Guangdong, Hubei, and Shanghai. It also has overseas operations related to infrastructure projects in Sri Lanka. The new energy business is expanding domestically and exploring Southeast Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dagang Holding operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures high-end construction machinery and equipment, provides integrated operation and maintenance services, and supplies charging infrastructure products. It also offers equipment leasing and technical consulting, positioning itself as both a manufacturer and service provider within the construction and new energy ecosystems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on integrating high-end equipment manufacturing with green energy and rural revitalization, guided by national policies on carbon peak and new industrialization. R&D priorities include intelligent and new energy product development, waste treatment technology innovation, and product optimization for market competitiveness. The company emphasizes modular design, smart IoT integration, and environmental sustainability in its innovation efforts.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of road construction machinery, public facility management services, waste treatment equipment, and electric vehicle charging stations. Additional income streams include equipment leasing, technical consulting, and after-sales services. The company also earns government subsidies and investment income, with a small portion from export sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dagang Holding is positioned as a high-end equipment manufacturer with a diversified business model including smart operation services and new energy solutions. It competes in the domestic construction machinery and environmental equipment markets, facing challenges from lower-priced competitors due to its premium product positioning. The company leverages its technological patents, comprehensive service offerings, and brand reputation to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 155 million, a 39% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 115 million. The decline is attributed to subdued market demand and asset impairment provisions. The company’s total assets stood at around RMB 889 million, reflecting a contraction from prior years. Despite recent losses, the company is investing in new energy and innovation to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dagang Holding emphasizes its advanced technology, comprehensive product range, and integrated service capabilities as key differentiators. Its products feature intelligent, environmentally friendly designs with patented technologies. The company offers end-to-end solutions including equipment sales, leasing, technical consulting, and after-sales support, aiming to maximize customer value through quality, innovation, and sustainability aligned with national strategic priorities.
